title: Patna High Court Technical Assistant Syllabus 2026
vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Technical Assistant
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF from portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://patnahighcourt.gov.in
2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF
3. Download Patna High Court Technical Assistant Syllabus 2026
4. Note exam pattern and marking scheme
5. Prepare topic-wise as per official units
shortDescription: Patna High Court Technical Assistant Syllabus 2026 – computer and general topics.
content:
Patna High Court Technical Assistant syllabus emphasizes computer knowledge along with general aptitude.

Key areas

  • Computer fundamentals, OS, MS Office
  • Networking / Internet basics
  • Database / hardware basics as notified
  • General English / Hindi
  • Reasoning and Quantitative Aptitude

Refer the official recruitment notice on the Patna High Court website.
